user.title: Choose a Rain Bird controller
user.description: Pick the Rain Bird controller this scheduler will drive. The scheduler uses the core Rain Bird integration's entities and never opens its own connection.

authority.title: Schedule authority
authority.description: Decide who owns automatic watering. In 'Home Assistant authoritative' mode you should disable native Rain Bird programs (or set their runtimes to zero) yourself — this integration never rewrites native schedules. Native Rain Bird schedules and Home Assistant schedules can conflict if both are active.

data.acknowledge_conflict: I understand that native Rain Bird schedules and Home Assistant schedules can conflict

error.acknowledge_required: You must acknowledge the schedule-conflict warning to continue.

abort.no_controllers: No unclaimed Rain Bird controllers were found. Set up the core Rain Bird integration first, or remove the existing scheduler for this controller.
abort.already_configured: This Rain Bird controller already has a scheduler.

missing_source.title: Rain Bird controller missing for {title}
missing_source.description: The Rain Bird config entry this scheduler was bound to no longer exists. Programs and history are preserved. Re-add the Rain Bird integration for this controller, then reload the scheduler entry.

zone_unresolved.title: Irrigation zone cannot be resolved: {zone}
zone_unresolved.description: The zone's source entity failed validation and the scheduler refuses to water it: {error}. Check that the Rain Bird integration still provides this zone and that it was not replaced by a different controller.

run_program.name: Run program
run_program.description: Start a scheduler program now as a manual run.

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

run_zones.name: Run zones
run_zones.description: Run an ordered list of zones for explicit durations. All zones must belong to one Rain Bird controller; the scheduler serializes them one at a time.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Ordered list of {entity_id, duration} items (duration in whole minutes, 1-1440).

stop_controller.name: Stop controller
stop_controller.description: Stop ALL watering on the controller (Rain Bird has no per-zone stop).

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

pause.name: Pause run
pause.description: Stop the controller but keep the active run resumable.

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

resume.name: Resume run
resume.description: Resume a paused run if it is still within the missed-run tolerance.

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

skip_current.name: Skip current zone
skip_current.description: Stop the current zone (controller-wide stop) and continue with the next step.

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry

config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

set_program_enabled.name: Enable/disable program
set_program_enabled.description: Enable or disable a scheduler program.

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).

set_rain_delay.name: Set rain delay
set_rain_delay.description: Set the native Rain Bird rain delay in DAYS. It suppresses native automatic programs but does not itself block manual zone runs; the scheduler separately honors it per program rain policy.

days.name: Days
days.description: Rain delay in days (0 clears it).

config_entry_id.name: Scheduler entry
config_entry_id.description: Scheduler config entry id (optional when only one exists).
